subject: prd/local-work-tracker
statement: When asked to append a decision record under a named namespace (e.g. triage disposition, worker charter, classification), the tracker shall store it as typed, schema-versioned structured data with latest-wins-per-namespace semantics, gated so an identical repeat is a no-op.
rationale: decision records replace the HTML-comment marker grammar with contractual data (INV-39/RW-3); marker-gating keeps sweeps idempotent (PLAN-8)
fit_criterion: a namespace's latest record is authoritative; a repeat writes nothing; records parse against their schema
